$comment: TimberTech (composite and PVC decking, railing and trim, AZEK) runs a server-rendered site with collection pages under /product/<collection>/ (for example /product/pro-legacy-collection/). The collection name is the h1, the description is the meta description and the image is og:image. TimberTech sells through dealers and lumberyards, so there is no price and no stock signal: price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The board sizes, finishes and colour options are in tabs rendered in a form the selectors do not read, so fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns the collection specs (6 on the sample), with the image and description, each checked against the page, at about 2,938+1,927 tokens per request. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and description; browser: the same; ai-crawler-avalai: the same plus 6 specs. ai-crawler-avalai is selected because it returns the specs. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) Legacy Collection page on 2026-11-19.
